about: Who keeps each source current, and when it is next checked (Lesson 7: a shared assistant needs an owner, a source revision and a review date). Owner is a role, not a person. After a review, set last_reviewed and next_review; if a source changed, replace the file in data/raw/, rebuild (python -m preprocess.build_all, python -m ingest.build_index) and rerun the dev evaluation. service.health() lists overdue sources and the website shows them.
